name: live-notebook-video
description: The Live Notebook film on the home page, made with Remotion, with a soundtrack synthesized in scripts/soundtrack.mjs. Renders to docs/media/live-notebook.mp4.

scripts.studio: npm run prepare-assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts LiveNotebook ../docs/media/live-notebook.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=22 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=160k
